lines.en: label halloweenmakoto2:
scene makotosekai1
: Okay, so...this {i}isn’t{/i} where we come from. But it also kind of...is? In a...really weird and confusing sort of way?
lines.zh: : 好吧，这么说吧……这儿{i}不是{/i}我们来的地方。但又有点……是？以一种……非常奇怪又让人摸不着头脑的方式？

lines.en: : What’s the point of trying to make sense of it at all when we’re just going to bounce around to another place that’s meant to torment me next?
lines.zh: : 反正我们马上又要跳到另一个专门用来折磨我的地方去了，那搞清楚这些到底有什么意义？

lines.en: : I’m not trying to make sense of it, Sensei. How could I? I’m just trying to...you know. I’m trying to gather information and whatnot so we can at least get a better idea of how things work here.
lines.zh: : 我不是想搞懂它，Sensei。我怎么可能搞得懂？我只是想……你知道的。我想收集点信息什么的，好让我们至少对这里的运作方式有个更清楚的了解。

lines.en: : Sure. Yeah. Information. Maya doesn’t exist. Ami is my daughter. Sekai is still alive.
lines.zh: : 当然。是啊。信息。Maya 不存在。Ami 是我女儿。Sekai 还活着。

lines.en: scene makotosekai2
: Which isn’t even taking into account the fact that she can stand there and listen to us talk about this without asking any questions.
lines.zh: : 这还没算上她能站在那儿听我们聊这些、却一个问题都不问的事实。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m being a good girl and saving all of my questions for the end. Plus, this time travel stuff is really interesting and I like hearing how sad you become when I’m not around to hold you anymore.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我这可是乖乖把问题全攒到最后再问。再说了，这时间旅行的事真的很有意思，而且我喜欢听你说，没有我在身边抱着你的时候你有多难过。

lines.en: : Miss Arakawa-
lines.zh: : Arakawa 小姐——

lines.en: scene makotosekai3
: Ew, stop. Just call me Sekai, please. I may have married your teacher, but that doesn’t mean I want to be referred to as {i}Miss{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 呃，别。请直接叫我 Sekai。我也许是嫁给了你的老师，但不代表我想被人称作什么{i}小姐{/i}。

lines.en: : We’re {i}married{/i} too?
lines.zh: : 我们也{i}结婚{/i}了？

lines.en: scene makotosekai4
: Of course we are, Aki-kun. You didn’t want Ami thinking she was born out of wedlock so you proposed three nights into our stay in Kyoto.
lines.zh: : 我们当然结婚了，Aki-kun。你不想让 Ami 以为自己是非婚生子女，所以在我们到京都的第三天晚上就求婚了。

lines.en: scene makotosekai5
: Oh, how beautiful the Kamo river was that-
lines.zh: : 哦，那天鸭川有多美啊——

lines.en: scene makotosekai6
: Yeah. I don’t care. Please stop talking.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我不在乎。请别说了。

lines.en: : {i}Oooooh!{/i} You become rather stern in a timeline without me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : {i}哦哦哦！{/i}在没有我的时间线里，你变得相当严厉了呢？

lines.en: : Do you really just...believe us? Without us needing to try and explain anything?
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么……相信我们？都不需要我们费劲解释什么？

lines.en: : Oh, Makoto. I’ve come to terms with far stranger things than this. Like, just look at how Aki-kun is acting right now. Even {i}that's{/i} weirder than the idea of alternate timelines, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦，Makoto。比这更离谱的事我都已经接受了。比如，你看看 Aki-kun 现在的样子。就连{i}那个{/i}都比什么平行时间线更诡异，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m...not sure I follow.
lines.zh: : 我……不太明白你的意思。

lines.en: : Well, if what you guys were talking about just a few minutes ago is true — what with Akira getting all depressed and running away after my death — shouldn’t he be {i}happy{/i} to return somewhere like this?
lines.zh: : 好吧，如果你们几分钟前说的都是真的——什么 Akira 在我死后一蹶不振、离家出走之类的——那他回到这种地方，不是应该很{i}开心{/i}才对吗？

lines.en: : If it’s even “returning” at all, that is. But it sounds to me like he’s gotten everything he wanted and hasn’t even had to work for it here! That’s great news! Now, who wants a drink?
lines.zh: : 如果这算得上「回到」的话。不过听起来，他在这儿得到了想要的一切，而且根本没费一点力气！这可是天大的好消息！那么，有谁想喝一杯吗？

lines.en: scene makotosekai7
: Sensei, you don’t have to listen to her. I know it’s-
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不必听她的。我知道这——

lines.en: : No, she’s {i}right.{/i} She’s always fucking right. That’s how she is. And by all accounts, I should be happier right now. The thing that tore my life apart just...somehow didn’t happen here.
lines.zh: : 不，她{i}说得对{/i}。她永远是他对妈的。她就是这样的人。而且不管从哪方面看，我现在都该更高兴才对。那件把我人生撕碎的事，就这么……在这儿没有发生。

lines.en: : But instead of being happy, I’m just...fucking {i}mad.{/i} Mad that somewhere else, I get to live the life I’ve always wanted while the {i}real{/i} me or...whatever version of myself I am right now has to suffer endlessly.
lines.zh: : 可我没有高兴，只是……他妈的{i}愤怒{/i}。气的是在另一个地方，我能过上我一直想要的人生，而{i}真正的{/i}我——或者说我现在这个版本的自己——却得无休止地受苦。

lines.en: : I mean...you don’t {i}have{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你{i}不必{/i}这样。

lines.en: scene makotosekai8
: You could just shove all that time-hopping stuff to the side and stay here with your beautiful family and loving roster of horny high-school girls.
lines.zh: : 你可以把那些跳时间的事全扔到一边，留在这儿，陪着你美丽的家人和那一大群爱你又饥渴的女高中生。

lines.en: : If you want another kid, though, you’re going to have to find somebody else. Childbirth hurts {i}way{/i} worse than people make it sound. And they already make it sound pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是还想要个孩子，就得另找别人了。生孩子疼起来{i}可远比{/i}别人说的更厉害。而别人本来就把它说得很吓人了。

lines.en: : Is there any chance you could maybe...be a little more gentle right now? Sensei’s already been having a tough time lately and I can’t imagine this is making it any easier.
lines.zh: : 你有没有可能……稍微温和一点？Sensei 最近已经很不好过了，我实在想不出这能让他好受半分。

lines.en: scene makotosekai9

: I still don’t get why he doesn’t just...{i}not{/i} have one anymore, though. Because, at least from my perspective, it sounds like the boy I fell in love with is trying to escape from me right now. And I don’t like that.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是不明白，他为什么不干脆就……{i}别{/i}再想那些了。因为至少从我的角度来看，听起来我爱上的那个男孩现在正想躲开我。而我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I think what Sensei was trying to say is that he {i}isn’t{/i} that boy, though. He’s changed from the way you were when {i}you{/i} knew him because he’s had to spend half of his life moving on.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得 Sensei 想说的是，他{i}已经不是{/i}那个男孩了。他变了，不再是{i}你{/i}认识他时的样子，因为他不得不花半辈子的时间往前走。

lines.en: : Yeah. The sooner we figure out how the fuck we can get out of here, the sooner you can go back to living your fairy-tale of a life while taking the time to still haunt me in mine.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们越早搞清楚到底该怎么离开这儿，你就能越早回去过你那童话般的人生，同时还能抽空继续在我的人生里阴魂不散。

lines.en: scene makotosekai10
: I {i}haunt{/i} you too? Boy, that does sound rough.
lines.zh: : 我还{i}阴魂不散{/i}地缠着你？天哪，听起来可真够呛。

lines.en: scene makotosekai11
: Is it just, like, mentally? Or does my ghost actually show up sometimes? Do I look all cool and transparent? Am I tangible? Do we still have sex?
lines.zh: : 只是精神上的那种？还是说我的鬼魂真的会出现？我看上去是不是又酷又透明？我能被摸到吗？我们还有性生活吗？

lines.en: : Please...just go away.
lines.zh: : 拜托……走开吧。

lines.en: : Heheh. He’s cute when he’s angry- isn’t he, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿。他生气的时候真可爱——是不是，Makoto？

lines.en: : Miss-
lines.zh: : 小姐——

lines.en: : {i}Sekai,{/i} Makoto. Sekai. Se-ka-i.
lines.zh: : {i}Sekai，{/i}Makoto。叫我 Sekai。Se-ka-i。

lines.en: scene makotosekai12
: Sekai, then...sorry...
lines.zh: : 那……Sekai……抱歉……

lines.en: : I was just wondering if...you’d be willing to leave the two of us alone now that we’ve...filled you in on what’s going on and...why we’re {i}both{/i} particularly frazzled right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问……既然我们已经……把情况都跟你说了，也说了为什么我们{i}俩{/i}现在都特别崩溃，你愿不愿意让我们两个单独待会儿？

lines.en: : Why, I can’t just rejoin the party now that I know I’m in the presence of time-travelers! Especially ones inhabiting the body of two of my favorite people.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，既然我知道自己正跟时间旅行者待在一起，我怎么能就这么回去参加派对呢！尤其是他们占据的还是两个我最喜欢的人的身体。

lines.en: scene makotosekai13
: M-Me? But why am {i}I-{/i}
lines.zh: : 我——我？可为什么{i}我——{/i}

lines.en: scene makotosekai14
: Aww! Aki-kun’s not the only one who’s lost all of his memories of our precious little life, is he?
lines.zh: : 哎呀！原来不是只有 Aki-kun 把那段宝贵的小生活忘得一干二净啊，是吧？

lines.en: : I...I don’t believe either one of us has lost {i}anything.{/i} We simply aren’t meant to be here. But-
lines.zh: : 我……我不认为我们俩谁{i}丢失了{/i}什么。我们只是本就不该在这儿。可是——

lines.en: scene makotosekai15
: But you {i}are{/i} here. And surely that wouldn’t have happened without a reason, right?
lines.zh: : 可你们{i}确实{/i}在这儿。而既然发生了，总该有个理由吧？

lines.en: : Things happen without a reason all the time where we come from. Every few months, actually. We just...normally get sent to a different space in the same timeline rather than a new one entirely.
lines.zh: : 在我们来的地方，没有理由就发生的事太多了。其实每隔几个月就有一次。只不过……我们通常是被送到同一条时间线里的另一个空间，而不是一整套全新的时间线。

lines.en: : Well, maybe that timeline ended?
lines.zh: : 那么，也许那条时间线结束了？

lines.en: scene makotosekai16
: E...Ended?...
lines.zh: : 结……结束了？……

lines.en: : Yeah. You guys said something about Ayane before, didn’t you? But, based on the fact she’s not in here with us, it’s probably safe to say she didn’t come along for the ride. So maybe she’s just gone?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你们之前提到过 Ayane，对吧？不过既然她没跟我们一起在这儿，大概可以肯定她没跟着过来。所以也许她就这么没了？

lines.en: : Don’t...

: Don’t {i}what,{/i} Aki-kun? There’s an Ayane here too. And she loves you a whole, whole lot. So if you had some kind of {i}illicit{/i} relationship with her back “home,” it wouldn’t be hard to replicate here.
lines.zh: : 别{i}什么，{/i}Aki-kun？这儿也有一个 Ayane。而且她非常非常爱你。所以如果你在「家里」跟她有什么{i}不正当{/i}的关系，在这儿复制一份并不难。

lines.en: : You’d just...endorse that sort of thing? Even though the two of you are married?
lines.zh: : 你就这么……赞成这种事？哪怕你们俩已经结婚了？

lines.en: scene makotosekai17
: Wow. You really have {i}no{/i} knowledge of life here then, do you?
lines.zh: : 哇。看来你对这边的生活真是一{i}无所知{/i}啊，是吧？

lines.en: : No! That’s what I’ve been trying to tell you! And it’s near impossible to get my bearings with you looming over my shoulder like that!
lines.zh: : 对！这就是我一直想告诉你的！而且你这样杵在我背后盯着，我几乎根本没法理清头绪！

lines.en: scene makotosekai18
: How about I just remind you then?
lines.zh: : 那我帮你回忆一下怎么样？

lines.en: : Wha-
: Sekai...{i}don’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sekai……{i}别。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, Aki-kun. Don’t tell me you become a prude after I die? Nothing would hurt me more than hearing how all of the work I put in was all for nothing.
lines.zh: : 哦，Aki-kun。别告诉我我死了之后你反倒变得拘谨了？没有什么比听到我付出的全部心血都白费了更让我伤心的了。

lines.en: scene makotosekai19
: What...are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你……在做什么？

lines.en: : Cheering Aki-kun up of course! Nothing fixes him quicker than a little tag-team action, Makoto. You and I do that sort of thing together all the time here.
lines.zh: : 当然是让 Aki-kun 高兴起来啊！没有什么比一点双人配合更能让他快速恢复的了，Makoto。你和我在这儿经常一起做这种事。

lines.en: scene makotosekai20
: We do?!
lines.zh: : 我们有吗？！

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Like once a week during the summer. It slows down when the weather gets cold, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，有啊。夏天大概一周一次。不过天冷了就少了。

lines.en: : H...How did things even get to that point?!
lines.zh: : 怎……事情怎么会发展到那一步的？！

lines.en: : Maybe you just have a thing for teachers? I don’t know. It was Aki-kun’s idea, not mine. He just said something about how we can trust you and I took his word for it.
lines.zh: : 也许你就好老师这一口？我也不知道。那是 Aki-kun 的主意，不是我的。他只是说了句我们信得过你，我就信了他的话。

lines.en: : But hey, if you’d rather just watch, I can take care of him myself.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，如果你更想只在旁边看着，我自己来伺候他也行。

lines.en: : It’s probably been a while since he’s felt my touch unless he kept my body around or something. {i}Or{/i} if he can have sex with my ghost, which he never confirmed is possible or not.
lines.zh: : 除非他把我的尸体留着什么的，他大概很久没感受过我的触碰了。{i}又或者{/i}他能跟我的鬼魂做爱——他从来没确认过那到底行不行。

lines.en: scene makotosekai21
: Sensei-
lines.zh: : Sensei——

lines.en: : Fuck it. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。来吧。

lines.en: : Go ahead?!
lines.zh: : 来吧？！

lines.en: scene makotosekai22
: You heard the teacher, Makoto! Or shall I say {i}teachers?{/i} You better do what we say if you don’t want to be disciplined.
lines.zh: : 你听到老师的话了，Makoto！还是说我该说{i}老师们{/i}？你要是不想被管教，最好照我们说的做。

lines.en: : I don’t...this isn’t...this clearly isn’t the time to-
lines.zh: : 我不……这不是……现在显然不是时候——

lines.en: : I said fuck it, Makoto. If we’re going to be stuck here, we might as well indulge in whatever shit keeps our mind off of it. Besides, there’s no stopping her when she gets like this.
lines.zh: : 我说了管他呢，Makoto。既然我们被困在这儿，那不如就沉溺在能让我们不去想它的任何事里。再说，她一旦这样了，谁也拦不住。

lines.en: scene makotosekai23
: Did you hear that? There’s no stopping me when I get like this. That means you can do anything you want and not have to blame yourself. How fun.
lines.zh: : 听到了吗？我一旦这样了谁也拦不住。也就是说你想做什么都可以，不用自责。多好玩啊。

lines.en: : I don’t...even {i}like{/i} girls, though...
lines.zh: : 可我……根本{i}不喜欢{/i}女孩子啊……

lines.en: : But Aki-kun does! And it’s not like I’m going to kiss you or anything.
lines.zh: : 可 Aki-kun 喜欢啊！而且我又不会吻你什么的。

lines.en: scene makotosekai24
: We’ll just give this little guy a nice massage until {i}aaaaaaall{/i} the tension goes away.
lines.zh: : 我们就给这小家伙好好按个摩，直到{i}所——有——{/i}的紧绷都消失为止。

lines.en: : Sensei...you’re...already this-
lines.zh: : Sensei……你已经……这么——

lines.en: : Just do as she says, Makoto. It’s what I want. And it’s probably what {i}you{/i} want too since your whole mindset since being thrown into our Hell is that we can fuck each other’s brains out every minute of every day.
lines.zh: : 照她说的做就行，Makoto。这是我想要的。大概也是{i}你{/i}想要的——毕竟自从被丢进我们这个地狱之后，你一脑子都在想我们可以每时每刻把对方操到脑子爆炸。

lines.en: : Awww, how sad it is that I couldn’t be the one to get sent to {i}your{/i} world instead. That sounds like fun.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真遗憾被送到{i}你{/i}那个世界的人不是我。听起来挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Though, I might have a harder time being gentle after hearing that since finding out you can still get it up after I’m gone makes me mad.
lines.zh: : 不过听完那些，我可能就没那么温柔了，因为发现我不在你身边你照样硬得起来，让我很火大。

lines.en: scene makotosekai25
: Maybe I’ll just have to hold it shut so you can’t cum. Heheh...
lines.zh: : 也许我干脆得把它捏住，让你射不出来。嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Shouldn’t I at least...take my gloves off? Or-
lines.zh: : 我至少该……把手套脱了吧？还是——

lines.en: : No, no, no. Keep them on. The friction will only hurt at first. And probably after. But hey, pain later is worth pleasure now, right?
lines.zh: : 不不不。戴着。摩擦感起初只会有点疼。之后大概也会疼。不过嘿，以后疼换现在爽，值了，对吧？

lines.en: : I...I suppose...so?...
: How’s it feel, Aki-kun? Did you ever get to experiment with Makoto in a Halloween costume where {i}you{/i} come from?
lines.zh: : 感觉怎么样，Aki-kun？在{i}你{/i}来的地方，你有没有试过穿着万圣节戏服的 Makoto？

lines.en: : I took her virginity right here while she was wearing that.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿拿走了她的第一次，当时她穿的就是那身。

lines.en: : Did you really need to tell her that?...
lines.zh: : 你真的非得告诉她这个吗？……

lines.en: : What’s the point in hiding it? I already told you I don’t give a shit anymore. I’m done. Just jerk me off or fuck me or whatever you want to do. I don’t care. I just don’t want to think.
lines.zh: : 藏着有什么意义？我已经跟你说过了，我什么都不在乎了。我受够了。给我打飞机也好，操我也好，随便你们想干什么。我不在乎。我只是不想思考。

lines.en: scene makotosekai26
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : That’s it...call him “Sensei...”
lines.zh: : 就是这样……叫他「Sensei……」

lines.en: : Aki-kun loves that, doesn’t he? Remember when you used to call {i}me{/i} that? My, how the tables have turned. But you’re still just as energetic as ever even on the opposite end of things.
lines.zh: : Aki-kun 最喜欢这个了，不是吗？还记得你以前也这么叫{i}我{/i}吗？哎呀，真是风水轮流转。不过哪怕位置完全反过来了，你还是一如既往地生龙活虎。

lines.en: scene makotosekai27
: And {i}you,{/i} Makoto...you’re a bad girl, aren’t you? Diligent and studious on the outside...just eagerly waiting for two adults to come take advantage of you. What would your mother think?
lines.zh: : 还有{i}你，{/i}Makoto……你是个坏女孩，对吧？表面上勤奋好学……心里就等着两个成年人来占你便宜。你妈妈会怎么想？

lines.en: : I personally...prefer being alone with him, but-
lines.zh: : 我个人……更喜欢跟他单独在一起，不过——

lines.en: : Buuuuuuuuullshit. You love this. Two teachers is better than one, even {i}if{/i} one of them has a pussy. It’s the dynamic that turns you on, not the equipment.
lines.zh: : 放——屁。你爱死这个了。两个老师比一个好，{i}就算{/i}其中一个有穴。让你兴奋的是这种关系，不是那副器官。

lines.en: : I can feel your heat...how badly you want Aki-kun to fuck your little slit while I watch. Is that your way of putting me in my place? Do you hate how forward I’m being tonight?
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到你的热气……你多想让 Aki-kun 当着我的面操你那道小缝。这就是你给我下马威的方式吗？你讨厌我今晚这么主动？

lines.en: : Miss-
lines.zh: : 小姐——
